name: review-form
title: Review form
description: Collect a review or testimonial: stars, headline, story, name and an unticked permission to publish, with busy, sent and error states announced.
docs: Pass onSubmit(review) (it may return a promise), title and an optional description. The review is { rating, headline, story, name, role, email, photo, consent }; rating, story, first name and consent are required, the rest optional, and fields switches the role field (on by default) and the photo field (off; it is a Choose a photo button with a small preview, the file name and a button to take the picture away again). Consent starts unchecked and says exactly what may be published; privacy replaces the line under it (a sensible default is built in; pass links to your privacy page). Problems appear under the field, the field is marked invalid and described by its message (the stars, the story and the consent box as well as the text fields), and focus goes to the first one. While the promise is pending the fields lock and the button shows a spinner; when it resolves the confirmation replaces the form in place, takes focus and shows what was sent, with after for the next step; when it rejects an alert appears above the button and takes focus, one Tab from trying again, and every value is kept for another try. A polite live region announces sending, sent and the problems found. To drive the state yourself (a server action, a mutation) pass status ('idle' | 'busy' | 'done' | 'error') and error; defaultValues pre-fills the fields and restores a form after a failed server action. labels carries every fixed word, so the form can speak any language.
